subject: Pre-invoice dependencies and stage lock for ACME renewal
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22 09:15 -0800
Subject: Pre-invoice checklist & PO timing for ACME renewal

Hi Jasmine / Jordan —

Quick note from finance to make sure we have everything in place for bookings recognition on the ACME renewal:

Must-haves before we can invoice and recognize:
- Signed SOW or DocuSign envelope completed (please confirm SOW is signed by end of day)
- Purchase Order number from ACME procurement (exact PO text and billing contact)
- Billing contact email for invoice delivery and remittance
- Any requested invoice split or milestone dates (if ACME wants split billing)

Timing constraints:
- If we receive signed SOW + PO by 2026-11-30 23:59 PST, we can include the booking in November recognition window.
- PO receipt after 2026-11-30 pushes recognition to December close, which affects this quarter's numbers.

Attachments: preinvoice_checklist.xlsx (stub) — checklist with required fields and example PO wording.

Jordan, can you confirm:
1) Who at ACME will issue the PO (name + email)?
2) Do they expect a single invoice or split milestones?
3) Any billing restrictions (PO number on invoice, remit-to address)?

Jasmine — please lock the opportunity stage to "Commit" in CRM once Jordan confirms PO timeline so we have a clean audit trail for finance. If we need to arrange pro-forma invoicing, flag that now.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-22 11:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-invoice checklist & PO timing for ACME renewal

Thanks Vivek — copying ACME procurement.

Quick answers:
- PO will be issued by Maria Gomez (maria.gomez@acme.com). Expect draft by EOD 11/22, final signed PO by 11/25 morning.
- They prefer a single invoice for the annual renewal but will accept two invoices if necessary for accounting; prefer net-30 remittance.
- PO text: please include Redwood Inference as the vendor, a reference to SOW #SOW-ACME-2026, and billing address on file.

I've attached the draft PO we're circulating internally — ACME_PO_Draft.pdf (stub). I'll confirm the exact PO number as soon as procurement sends it.

Jordan Price
Senior Account Manager | ACME Corp

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22 13:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-invoice checklist & PO timing for ACME renewal

Jordan — great, thanks for the heads up and for looping procurement.

Plan on our side (next steps):
- I'll mark the HubSpot opportunity stage as "Commit" after this thread and add a note with the expected PO delivery date (11/25).
- Vivek / Finance: please confirm that receiving the signed SOW + PO by 11/25 still allows November recognition (given internal close schedules). If not, we'll note impact in the forecast.
- Jordan: once Maria confirms, please share the final PO number and the exact billing contact. If ACME wants two invoices, confirm the split dates so we can align invoice dates to recognition rules.

I attached a short mutual action plan for clarity — mutual_action_plan.md (stub). Also linking the HubSpot deal: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2026-Renew-6782

If you prefer, we can lock billing terms via DocuSign for the SOW: https://www.docusign.com/s/so-ACME-SOW-2026

Thanks — I'll update the opportunity and follow up if finance needs anything else.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0189

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-23 10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-invoice checklist & PO timing for ACME renewal

Quick follow-up after reviewing timing with accounting: receiving both SOW and final PO by 11/25 will still qualify for November recognition, but we need the final PO number and billing contact in CRM by EOD 11/25 to pass internal audit checks. Otherwise the booking moves to December.

One small nuance: if ACME sends a PO without the exact SOW reference, we can still invoice but must attach an internal cross-reference which delays the close process by ~24 hours. Tell procurement to include SOW-ACME-2026 in the PO text.

Action items (owner / due):
- Jordan: confirm final PO number + billing contact (due 2026-11-25 EOD)
- Jasmine: update HubSpot opportunity stage to "Commit" and add PO fields (due 2026-11-25 EOD)
- Vanessa (CS/Finance liaison): once PO is received, please confirm invoice date and whether split invoicing is requested (due within 4 hours of PO receipt)

I'll standby for the PO. If anything slips, flag on the deal so forecasting reflects the change.

Thanks,
Vivek
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
